verdict.rationale: Multilingual transcription and summaries are a fair question for an AI meeting recorder like Fathom, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions supported languages, non-English transcription, or handling of language switching. Generic transcription and summary claims (unlimited transcriptions, instant AI summaries) do not establish multilingual support.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run meetings in languages other than English — transcription and summaries support many languages and handle language switching
